default_description: Turkish publishing group representing translation rights to children's books, fiction and non-fiction, with rights sold in almost 70 languages.
llms_intro: Epsilon Publishing Group (Istanbul, founded 1993) is one of Türkiye's leading publishing groups, with the imprints Epsilon, Kafka, Uçan Fil, Nemesis, Masalperest, Nora, Serenad, Okuyan Us and Okuyan Koala. Its rights team represents the group's authors and titles internationally: rights to more than 100 titles have been sold in almost 70 languages across 180 territories. This site lists every title available for translation, with its rights status, the rights catalogues and how to get in touch.
